I mean, you think, but someone said this, I heard this not so long and I thought it made so much sense. Internal combustion engine is one of the greatest inventions of all time. Can you talk about liberating and freedom? You fill up your gas, your car, under Trump for $2 a gallon, and you can drive 350 miles anywhere you want to go. You talk about freedom. So part of me is like, is that what the left is really out to stop? Is the freedom associated with oil and gas and internal, I mean, who knows, but I saw Rokana in a committee hearing a few months ago with the CEOs from all the big oil and gas companies, and he went down the line, badgering each witness saying, will you commit today to decreasing production? And I thought it was a crazy thing. And I said, after he got down, I said, what do you want? $8 gas? You want all the families that we get to represent. You want to take more of their money. You want to drive up inflation even higher, because energy is the base. You drive up the cost of energy. The cost of every good goes up, because you've got to move goods. And I'm like, but the truth is, Tim, they do. That's what they want. And that is why Joe Biden can't do the right thing right now with Ukraine on energy policy. He can't say, I want to open up AMAR, I want to open up the Keystone pipeline, I want to tell oil and gas companies drill and drill baby drill as we used to say, he can't do that because his party won't let him. I don't know if he wants to do that or not, but I know one thing, the left that controls his party will not allow him to do what's best for families in this country. And that is what is so wrong. And that's why I think we're going to win in November.
